title: Oven Roasted Greek Lamb Roast
description: A nutty and velvety Greek dish featuring lamb leg, perfect for a lazy Sunday, with a flexitarian-friendly twist using dashi extract for added depth of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the lamb leg and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the dashi extract, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the mixture all over the lamb leg, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the lamb leg in a roasting pan and put it in the oven.
Roast the lamb for 20 minutes per pound, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the lamb rest for 15 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve the lamb with your choice of sides, such as roasted vegetables or quinoa.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
